branches.source: brainHide watches a scream position, investigates own-group casualty, seeds building memory on another body, and otherwise lowers stance; rare indoor reposition.
branches.cbe: DangerEngineAct uses finite glance/stance and PointActorOperation for corroborated own-group casualties. DangerStep seeds bounded BODY_FOUND clue; group observation/search paths dispatch indoor work.
branches.disposition: Actor/group evidence split is intentional. Missing body object is not death provenance. Physical investigation and repeated entry/return still require evidence.

branches.disposition: Deliberate redesign instead of random unleased movement or unconditional authored-stance replacement. The2-actor investigation capacity is not whole-squad CLEAR capacity; do not conflate them.

dispositions.source: Weak stance applied first; PATH-disabled/indoor refuse movement. Empty destination searches nearby bush/tree/hide, then issues moveTo plus FORMATION PLANNED setDestination and nonforced gesture.
dispositions.cbe: Group finite DangerCoverStep owns refuge movement, requires current native order/epoch/operation/reservation proof and screens COVER versus CONCEALMENT. Actor immediate weak stance remains a separate exact-restoration lease. Do not add moveTo/setDestination to DangerEngineAct merely to match source call placement.

immediateHelperReview20261026.runtimeChange: None; existing implementations retained, no new defect established in this comparison.

suppressionHelperReview20261026.scope: Complete three readable helpers; compiled SQFC equivalence and all effective callers not established.
suppressionHelperReview20261026.intent: Terrain/optional material LOS, bounded-range aim adjustment and friendly proximity gate before native suppressive fire.
sourceDepartures: Source clamps far aim to200m and skips endpoint friendly query when original target exceeds200m. CBE retains believed target/nearby cover face and full protected-actor cone; do not copy skipped safety merely for matching range.

Source suppression-position helper uses2 returned surfaces and configured model blocking cache; CBE nearestFIRE/GEOM obstruction permits near-belief face within3m. Neither proves penetration/actual impact or real suppression quality.
Source friendly query is people-only side proximity. CBE shared lane also considers protected captives/civilians and vehicle positions, with bounded density refusal.
suppressionHelperReview20261026.cbeDefect: Suppression knew its loaded magazine but passed only actor/aim to shared firing-lane check, bypassing existing config-based aimpoint/near-impact blast veto for modded explosive bullets.
suppressionHelperReview20261026.implementation: Pass _magazine to existing CortexLineOfFireClear at suppression boundary. No extra controller/world query/worker. Explosive ammo uses existing additional ray and blast radius; nonexplosive ammo retains cone semantics with config validation.
suppressionHelperReview20261026.cost: One existing helper config lookup per eligible lane; explosive rounds additionally use its existing near-impact ray. Runtime cost unmeasured.
suppressionHelperReview20261026.limits: Config-radius and position observations are not ballistic impact or continuous friendly-fire proof. Modded explosive bullet balance/visuals/native bursts and performance require authorised physical validation.
